payload.description: Aspect build, not a rotation. Aspect of Beowulf on Shield of Chaos: pressing Cast loads bloodstones into the shield (no limit on stacking). Holding and releasing Attack triggers Dragon Rush (powered Bull Rush) which fires all loaded bloodstones as a radial AoE burst at the end of the rush movement. Unlike other shield aspects, bloodstones do NOT lodge in enemies — they accumulate in the shield and release together. Loop: load casts, then Dragon Rush to detonate. NOTE: corpus claim that 'bloodstone lodges in enemy, retrieve by bashing' is CONTRADICTED by multiple sources.
